facts.material: electronic DSP chipset in metal housing
facts.function: digital audio signal processing: DAC, crossover, EQ, level adjustment; no amplification
facts.form: electronic apparatus with rotary dial, RCA/XLR/S-PDIF I/O, wireless

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8543 electrical apparatus with individual functions not elsewhere specified; not an amplifier (8518.40) nor a loudspeaker part as it does not amplify

rejected_alternatives.reason: no amplification, so not an audio-frequency amplifier
a finished apparatus, not an integrated circuit
requires network connection for mixing of sound; device is a speaker processor with unspecified wireless link
not shown to be a part solely for loudspeakers

missing_facts: type of wireless connectivity (network vs simple Bluetooth)
whether device is dedicated to a single speaker brand
classification.rationale: DSP unit performing crossover/EQ/level adjustment without amplification falls in residual 8543.70.98, as the in-force effects-processor ruling N345901 did; uncertainty over 8543.70.91 if the wireless link is a network for sound mixing.
